text:
emily: Following up on the postmortem for yesterday's cross-region spike (eu-west -> us-east) where DNS TTL churn + LB route flip caused a burst of retries and TLS handshake timeouts. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2209999000. Creating this thread to lock owners, acceptance criteria, and rollout cadence.

todd: I saw repeated instances where route propagation lagged ~20-40s and the LB sticky mapping reassigned sessions to backends that didn't have the new route-version tag. That caused mid-handshake drops and a cascade of retries.

ying: did vendor registrar rate-limit surface again? last time that was a big lever.

emily: yes, registrar returned 202s on bulk updates during the maintenance window; that pushed some updates past our expected propagation window.

opsbot: Incident 2209999000 recorded: dns-shadowing-and-lb-fallback. Severity: P2. Linked tickets: INC-9805, TKT-2522.

marcus: draft remediation items (please edit):
- implement registrar update backoff/smoothing (owner: todd)
- add route-consistency preflight in deploy pipeline (owner: ying)
- add "sticky-handshake-guard" in LB: do not remap cookie during live handshake (owner: marcus)
- add route-consistency metric + synthetic (owner: cs)
- update runbook + customer blurb (owner: emily)

emily: owners + target dates? please list PR dates so we can schedule canary windows.

todd: registrar smoothing: I'll open PR by 2026-04-06, test in vendor sandbox 2026-04-07, target prod rollout 2026-04-10 if sandbox looks green. Vendor ticket VND-4801 created.

ying: route-consistency preflight: I'll add a deploy webhook that queries edge-route-status and checks route_version for a sample of edges. PR 2026-04-03, gate enabled for canary 2026-04-04. Gate rejects if mismatch_ratio > 0.5%.

marcus: sticky-handshake-guard: prototype by 2026-04-08. Idea: once a handshake starts, do not reassign cookie until handshake completes or times out; if route-version mismatch detected post-handshake, mark for drain instead of immediate remap. Canary 10% for 2h on 2026-04-09.

cs: synthetic & metric: will add a route-version checker that runs from eu-west every 5m and asserts X-RW-Route-Version header. PromQL for mismatch ratio proposal:
```
sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m])) / sum(rate(edge_requests_total[5m]))
```
I'll wire an alert: mismatch_ratio > 0.25% for 10m -> P3, escalate to P2 if >1% for 15m. Target: 2026-03-31.

emily: acceptance criteria (please confirm):
- registrar smoothing: registrar_update_error_rate < 0.01% for 24h in sandbox post-change OR vendor confirms staged API reduces 99th percentile propagation delay by >= 50%
- preflight gate: reject if mismatch_ratio > 0.5% on canary sample
- sticky-handshake-guard: during 10% canary, resume_fail_rate and 5xx should be <= baseline + 0.15% for 2h; no sticky-remap alerts
- synthetic: alarm fires as defined above
- runbook: PR merged and customer blurb approved by CS

todd: ack on acceptance criteria. I'll add a smoke test for registrar smoothing in sandbox: simulate 500 updates in 30s and measure registrar_update_errors_total and propagation window.

ying: preflight pseudo-check I'll include in webhook PR:
```
# deploy preflight
curl -s "https://edge-status.internal/route-version?sample=100" | jq '.mismatch_count'
# fail if mismatch_count / 100 > 0.005
```

marcus: note on guard: we must be careful to not cause head-of-line blocking. Guard will only prevent remap during an active TLS handshake (SYN -> handshake complete) and set a short max-hold (30s) before moving to drain mode. We'll add metrics: sticky_guard_blocked_total and sticky_guard_drain_count.

emily: please add those metric names in PRs so our dashboards can pick them up.

cs: customer comms: CS already notified top 5 customers. We'll prepare a post-canary blurb: short summary, what we changed, and recommended steps if they see issues. Target message draft by 2026-03-30.

todd: vendor update: VND-4801 responded - they can offer a staged-update endpoint but need us to reduce per-second update rate. I'll test tomorrow and attach results to INC-9805.

ying: smoke test checklist for deploy gate PRs:
- run route-version-checker 20x from eu-west -> expect X-RW-Route-Version == v71
- verify `sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m]))` < 5 over 15m during canary
- run TLS resume smoke: `openssl s_client -connect edge-proxy:443 -servername api.redwood.example -sess_out s.bin` then reconnect with `-sess_in s.bin` to confirm resume behavior

emily: rollback plans: if canary shows > baseline + 0.2% 5xx or guard increases user-visible latency, rollback steps are: revert lb-configmap, disable sticky-guard feature flag, and drain canary nodes back to previous pool. Marcus please post exact kubectl commands in PR.

marcus: will include kubectl rollback snippet and a quick runbook test in staging.

opsbot: Calendar: canary readiness sync scheduled 2026-04-05 15:00 UTC. Invite sent.

emily: final recap: owners + PR dates:
- todd: registrar smoothing PR 2026-04-06, vendor sandbox test 2026-04-07
- ying: deploy preflight PR 2026-04-03, gate enabled 2026-04-04
- marcus: sticky-handshake-guard PR 2026-04-08, canary 2026-04-09
- cs: synthetic + alert 2026-03-31, customer blurb draft 2026-03-30
- emily: runbook + postmortem actions updated 2026-03-31

cs: acked, will post the blurb to #customer-updates after review.

todd: ack, starting sandbox tests tomorrow.

ying: ack, opening PR later today.

emily: thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem actions page with these owners and will close this thread when PR links + runbook are attached. Reopen if blockers. :white_check_mark:
